showcase.intro: From the first conversation to the final destination, our focus is on honest communication, practical planning and treating people with respect.

process.intro: Every job starts with the details. We’ll discuss what needs moving, the route, and your timeframe before confirming availability and pricing.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.description: Share the items, dimensions, approximate weight, and pickup details.

steps.title: We plan the route
steps.description: We’ll discuss the journey, preferred date, and a quote for your transport.

steps.title: We arrange transport
steps.description: Once details are agreed, we’ll confirm the next steps for pickup and delivery.

story.paragraph1: Psalm 23 Transportation is a family-owned business founded by Isabella, her boyfriend, and her dad. Their shared Christian faith is at the heart of what they are building together.
story.storyImageAlt: Circular gold Christian emblem with mountains, winding road and multicoloured puzzle-heart
story.paragraph2: Like pieces in a puzzle, a successful journey depends on the details coming together. We aim to communicate clearly, treat people fairly, and approach each transportation request with care.
story.verse: “The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

hero.heroImageAlt: White flatbed hauling truck beneath a glowing Christian cross and mountain sunset, with open dark space to the left for the website headline
hero.intro: Psalm 23 Transportation offers family-owned flatbed hauling for equipment, materials, and other items. Guided by faith and focused on honest communication, we help you plan the journey from pickup to delivery.
hero.ribbon: PUTTING THE PIECES TOGETHER, FROM PICKUP TO DELIVERY.
